title: India's Statistical Base-Year Reset to 2022-23
summary: MoSPI revises base years for GDP (2022-23), IIP (2022-23), and CPI (2024=100) per Biswanath Goldar committee recommendations.

blocks.title: 📰 7. 🏆 AWARDS, BOOKS, INDICES & RANKINGS
blocks.text: 🪝 India's Statistical Base-Year Reset to 2022-23. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: MoSPI enacted a triple base-year revision for **GDP (2022-23)**, **IIP (2022-23)**, and **CPI (2024=100)** to align with IMF SDDS standards.
**Basket Expansion**: CPI (consumer price index tracking retail inflation) basket items increased from 299 to **358 items**.
**Weight Cut**: Food & Beverages weight cut to 36.75%.
